vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: jisu-news
Version: 1.0.1

The skill is a standard API wrapper for the Jisu News service (jisuapi.com). The Python script `news.py` correctly implements functions to fetch news channels and articles using the provided environment variable `JISU_API_KEY`. No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection was found; the code logic is transparent and aligns with the documentation in `SKILL.md`.

llm.summary: The skill's code and instructions match its description: it fetches news from the Jisu API and only requires a JISU_API_KEY and python3; there is a minor mismatch that it uses the Python 'requests' library but does not declare that dependency.

dimensions.detail: Name/description promise (fetch news via Jisu API) matches the code and runtime instructions. The only unexpected item is that news.py imports the Python 'requests' package but the skill metadata does not declare this dependency; otherwise required env var (JISU_API_KEY) and python3 are appropriate and proportional to the described purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs calling the included script to list channels or fetch channel news. The script only reads JISU_API_KEY from the environment, accepts a JSON argument, and calls the documented Jisu API endpoints—there is no access to unrelated files, other environment variables, or unexpected external endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec (instruction-only) so nothing is written to disk by an installer. Minor operational note: the script requires the third‑party Python package 'requests' at runtime but the skill manifest does not declare how to install it; this is an operational omission rather than a security red flag.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only JISU_API_KEY is required and is the primary credential; that is proportional to a news-API integration. The code does not request or read unrelated secrets or config paths.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-enabled and does not request elevated or persistent system privileges. It does not modify other skills or system settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it claims: call the Jisu news API and return results. Before installing, consider: (1) Provide a JISU_API_KEY scoped/limited to only the needed API quotas if possible; (2) ensure the runtime (agent) has network access and the Python 'requests' package installed (pip install requests) or the script will fail; (3) returned news items are sourced from the internet—be mindful of copyright when reposting; (4) the skill can be invoked autonomously by the agent (normal behavior), so only install if you trust the agent to make those outbound API calls using your API key.
